title: Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti's birth chart
metaDescription: Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 1.6° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Across the ten placements whose signs are settled, mutable leads with five. Mutable weight is read as flexibility, and the old texts are frank that its cost is scatter.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 1.6° Scorpio, inside the first decan (0°–10°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Mars. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 24.8° Scorpio, Venus was at 19.0° Virgo, Mars was at 16.1° Leo. Read together: thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that grows by reliability; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Jupiter and Uranus hold the closest angle here — a conjunction, 0.8° wide. When two functions occupy one degree, the tradition reads a fusion: neither can act without committing the other. Behind it, the Sun sextile Saturn at 1.0°, and Mars sextile Pluto at 1.3° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags four placements in this chart. The Moon in Scorpio at 22.9° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Virgo at 19.0° is in fall; Jupiter in Sagittarius at 11.1° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Capricorn at 0.6° is in domicile. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 3 water, 3 fire, 2 earth, 2 air by element and 5 mutable, 4 fixed, 1 cardinal by modality. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts. Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.1° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 22.9°.
